methods.limits: Format list includes MPEG-1 System and MPEG-PS; libx264 is an external library; -i and -c are described in the command-line documentation.
3GPP AMR is in the format list; MP3 encoding uses the external LAME library (--enable-libmp3lame).
Format list includes MPEG-1 System and MPEG-PS; libx264 is an external library.
MPEG-PS is listed as also known as VOB; libx264 is an external library.

methods.steps: File > Import > Audio and pick the AIFF; File > Export Audio; select MP3, set channels and sample rate, choose the entire project or the current selection; Export.
methods.limits: MP3 encoding settings are on a separate MP3 Export Options page.
-C with a positive integer is the MP3 bitrate in kbps; MP3 writing needs SoX built with LAME.
AIFF is in the format list; MP3 encoding uses the external LAME library.

methods.steps: File > Import > Audio; File > Export Audio; with the optional FFmpeg library installed choose M4A (AAC) (FFmpeg) and type a name ending in .m4r; Export.
methods.limits: The M4A (AAC) (FFmpeg) choice needs the optional FFmpeg library.
MP3 is in the format list; the ipod muxer writes an MPEG-4 audio file limited to audio streams.

methods.steps: Select the photo; Export; set Export as to JPEG; set Quality; optionally Change image size under Resolution with a Long edge value; choose Save in; Export.
methods.limits: Nikon's own guide to file conversion.

methods.steps: Open the OGG; File > Export Audio; name the file .wav; set Encoding (default Signed 16-bit PCM); choose the export range; Export.
methods.limits: WAV files are limited to 4 GB.
Ogg and PCM signed 16-bit little-endian are in the format and codec lists.
Output type comes from the file extension unless -t is given.

methods.steps: Shift+Ctrl+E or File > Export PNG Image; choose Page, Drawing, Selection or Custom; set size in pixels or resolution; filename; Export.
methods.limits: Import manual lists Illustrator files from 9.0 onward.
Format list shows AI as RW (Adobe Illustrator CS2).

methods.steps: Shift+Ctrl+E or File > Export PNG Image; choose Page, Drawing, Selection or Custom; set size in pixels or resolution; filename; Export.
methods.limits: Produces the PNG that the ImageMagick method starts from.
Input any image as long as it is square.
